content.title: Family-Owned Trash Truck Maker Snapped Up In Big Federal Signal Acquisition
content.summary: Federal Signal Corporation (NYSE: FSS) said Wednesday it will acquire Scranton Manufacturing Company Inc., known as New Way Trucks, in a $396 million deal, plus $30 million for facilities in Iowa and Mississippi. The agreement also includes up to $54 million in performance-based earnouts.
